## Experience
- Project Manager, Solar Neon Engineering Pvt Ltd (May 2025 to Mar 2026): 36 residential and commercial solar PV projects, 790 kWp, up to 40 crew across five concurrent sites.
- Senior Project Engineer, Islamabad Solar House Pvt Ltd (Feb 2023 to Apr 2025): full lifecycle on 59 PV installations from 5 kWp to 115 kWp.
